description: Source code for a Zephyr-based USB device implementing IEEE 802.15.4 radio communication, including USB configuration, command handling, and radio control functions.

methods.name: wpanusb_status_cb
methods.description: USB status callback handling various USB device states.

methods.name: wpanusb_vendor_handler
methods.description: Handles vendor-specific USB requests, queues packets for processing.

methods.name: set_channel
methods.description: Sets the IEEE 802.15.4 channel via radio API.

methods.name: set_ieee_addr
methods.description: Sets IEEE address filter on the radio.

methods.name: set_short_addr
methods.description: Sets short address filter on the radio.

methods.name: set_pan_id
methods.description: Sets PAN ID filter on the radio.

methods.name: tx
methods.description: Transmits a network packet via the radio.

methods.name: tx_thread
methods.description: Thread function handling queued transmission commands.

methods.name: net_recv_data
methods.description: Receives data from network stack and sends via USB.

methods.name: ieee802154_handle_ack
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment packets, currently continues processing.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing the device, network stack, and USB.
